bind_address.description: Public IPv4 address the Teredo server will bind to. Must be reachable from the internet.

port.description: UDP port number used for Teredo traffic. Must match firewall rules.

refresh_rate.description: Interval in seconds for Teredo clients to refresh their bindings. Lower values increase traffic.

max_clients_per_prefix.description: Maximum number of Teredo clients allowed per /32 client prefix. Prevents resource exhaustion.

log_file.description: Path to log file (e.g., /var/log/miredo/miredo-server.log). Empty string logs to stderr.

enable_server.description: Enable Teredo server functionality. Set to false to run only relay or for maintenance.

relay_interfaces.description: List of relay interfaces with IPv4 addresses and optional MTU settings. Required if acting as Teredo relay.

address.description: Public IPv4 address of the relay interface (e.g., 192.0.2.1).

mtu.description: MTU for Teredo packets on this interface (default: 1280 if omitted).

client_prefixes.description: List of IPv6 prefixes that clients will use (e.g., 2001:0000::/32). Multiple prefixes allow multiple deployment pools.

items.description: IPv6 prefix (CIDR notation) for client Teredo addresses.

trusted_prefixes.description: List of IPv4 prefixes considered trusted for relay operations (e.g., 192.0.2.0/24). Prevents spoofing.

items.description: IPv4 prefix in CIDR notation that is authorized for relay traffic.

client_pool_start.description: First IPv6 address in the client pool (must be within the client prefix range).

client_pool_end.description: Last IPv6 address in the client pool (must be within the client prefix range).

server_address.description: IPv6 address of the Teredo server itself (must be within client pool range).

enable_forwarding.description: Enable kernel IPv6 packet forwarding for Teredo tunneling. Required for relay/forwarding behavior.
